title: Disclosure, Materiality Thresholds, and the Cost of Capital: Evidence from Federal Open Market Committee Announcements
authors: Michael Dambra; Mihail Velikov; Joseph Peter Weber
eligible_reason: Continuous treatment, no staggered adoption. Firm x FOMC-period panel: reghdfe disclosure outcomes on c.targetsurprise_bp#c.mean_mpe_tv (continuous monetary-policy surprise x firm monetary-policy exposure) with ten time-varying firm controls, absorb(cusip_n periodnumber), cluster(cusip_n). Data not shipped (WRDS, RavenPack, IBES, SDC).
design_notes: Data built in MATLAB (dvw.m, AssayingAnomalies library), estimated in Stata (dvw.do). Outcomes: 8-K filings, press releases, management guidance (indicator and log count).
data_files_note: Only FOMC dates shipped; firm data must be rebuilt from licensed WRDS/RavenPack/IBES/SDC sources.
screener_notes: Abstract from OpenAlex frame; no article text.
